A1_COMBINATION_RARITY.label: Combination rarity
A1_COMBINATION_RARITY.meaning: Rarity or surprise of co-cited source pairs relative to strictly prior prevalence.
A1_COMBINATION_RARITY.meaning_short: Co-cited pair rarity relative to prior prevalence.
A1_COMBINATION_RARITY.include: Explicit observed/expected or prior-overlap statistic with T0-frozen history.
A1_COMBINATION_RARITY.include_short: Observed/expected or prior-overlap formula; T0-frozen history.
A1_COMBINATION_RARITY.exclude: Threshold-only or monotone variants; post-publication reference sets.

A2_ATYPICALITY_CONVENTIONALITY.label: Atypicality & conventionality
A2_ATYPICALITY_CONVENTIONALITY.family_summary: Null-model z-score centre and left-tail variants
A2_ATYPICALITY_CONVENTIONALITY.meaning: Left-tail atypicality and central conventionality of source-pair null-model z scores.
A2_ATYPICALITY_CONVENTIONALITY.meaning_short: Tail atypicality and centre conventionality of null-model z scores.
A2_ATYPICALITY_CONVENTIONALITY.include: Source-defined tail and centre facets whose approximation matches an exact reference.
A2_ATYPICALITY_CONVENTIONALITY.exclude: Arbitrary quantiles, duplicate standardizations and unvalidated null models.
A2_ATYPICALITY_CONVENTIONALITY.exclude_short: Arbitrary quantiles, duplicate scaling, unvalidated null models.

A3_FIRST_TIME_COMBINATION.label: First-time combinations
A3_FIRST_TIME_COMBINATION.family_summary: First-pair incidence · distance weighting · future-confirmed variants
A3_FIRST_TIME_COMBINATION.meaning: Incidence or share of source pairs absent from the strictly prior literature.
A3_FIRST_TIME_COMBINATION.meaning_short: Share of source pairs absent from strictly prior literature.
A3_FIRST_TIME_COMBINATION.include: Explicit denominator and pre-T0 history; no future reuse in the T0 feature.
A3_FIRST_TIME_COMBINATION.include_short: Explicit denominator and pre-T0 history; no future reuse.
A3_FIRST_TIME_COMBINATION.exclude: Future-confirmed reuse, reference-count duplicates and unstable distance variants.
A3_FIRST_TIME_COMBINATION.exclude_short: Future-confirmed reuse, count duplicates, unstable distance variants.

A4_KNOWLEDGE_BREADTH_BALANCE.label: Knowledge breadth & balance
A4_KNOWLEDGE_BREADTH_BALANCE.family_summary: Category variety · focal-field breadth · balance · Hill categories
A4_KNOWLEDGE_BREADTH_BALANCE.meaning: Variety, relative spread and balance of scientific categories represented in prior references.
A4_KNOWLEDGE_BREADTH_BALANCE.meaning_short: Variety, spread and balance of fields in prior references.
A4_KNOWLEDGE_BREADTH_BALANCE.include: Theoretically distinct variety and balance families with paper-level scientometric use.
A4_KNOWLEDGE_BREADTH_BALANCE.exclude: Monotone rescalings, algebraic complements and multiple Hill orders as separate primaries.
A4_KNOWLEDGE_BREADTH_BALANCE.exclude_short: Monotone/algebraic duplicates; multiple Hill orders as primaries.

A5_COGNITIVE_DISTANCE_INTEGRATION.label: Cognitive distance & integration
A5_COGNITIVE_DISTANCE_INTEGRATION.family_summary: Field distance · Rao–Stirling/Porter · DIV · bridging · semantic distance
A5_COGNITIVE_DISTANCE_INTEGRATION.meaning: Cognitive disparity among referenced fields and their share-weighted integration.
A5_COGNITIVE_DISTANCE_INTEGRATION.include: One unweighted distance component and at most one weighted composite using prior profiles.
A5_COGNITIVE_DISTANCE_INTEGRATION.include_short: One distance component and at most one weighted composite.
A5_COGNITIVE_DISTANCE_INTEGRATION.exclude: Duplicate composites, future-trained spaces and unstable or unscalable graph measures.
A5_COGNITIVE_DISTANCE_INTEGRATION.exclude_short: Duplicate composites, future spaces, unstable graph measures.

threshold_statement: Primary gates: coverage ≥ .70 overall / .50 each field · resampling ρ ≥ .90, MRE ≤ .10 · approximation ρ ≥ .95, MRE ≤ .05
candidate_scope_note: Candidate families describe the reviewed universe, including excluded options; future-confirmed and external-data variants are not publication-time primary indicators.
